definitions.explanation: A striking difference between two things when compared side by side.
The act of comparing two things to find similarities or differences.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{意見|いけん}は{対照的|たいしょうてき}だ。
examples.english: The two opinions are in stark contrast.

examples.japanese: {原文|げんぶん}と{訳文|やくぶん}を{対照|たいしょう}する。
examples.english: To compare the original text with the translation.

examples.japanese: {光|ひかり}と{影|かげ}の{対照|たいしょう}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The contrast between light and shadow is beautiful.

notes:
COMMON FORMS:
- {対照的|たいしょうてき} (contrastive, contrasting - na-adjective)
- {対照|たいしょう}する (to compare, to contrast)
- 〜と{対照|たいしょう}をなす (to form a contrast with ~)

HOMOPHONE:
- {対照|たいしょう} (contrast) vs. {対象|たいしょう} (target, object)

RELATED TERMS:
- {比較|ひかく} (comparison - more general)
- {対比|たいひ} (comparison, contrast)
